summary: Measure how many items a collection contains.
documentation: len returns the number of items in a supported collection. For a list it counts elements, not the sizes of the values inside those elements.
inputs: A sequence or collection supporting the length protocol.
caution: len counts items. It does not sum numeric values or recursively count nested list elements.
scenarios: Count appointments in a dispatch list.
Check how many products were imported.
Show the number of selected contacts in a message composer.
title: Count the scheduled jobs
problem: Given a list of job identifiers, return the number of identifiers. Repeated identifiers still count as separate list entries.
goal: Use len() or an equivalent approach that demonstrates the same concept.
